command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# nipype needs a writable HOME (it writes ~/.nipype/nipype.cfg) and a writable TMPDIR.
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
# nipype writes per-node crash files and reports; collect anything it left behind so a
# failure is diagnosable without a rerun.
( cd /tmp && find . -maxdepth 3 -name 'crash-*' -o -maxdepth 3 -name '_report' -type d \
   | head -40 | tar -czf /tmp/nipype-diag.tar.gz -T - ) 2>/dev/null || true
test -f /tmp/nipype-diag.tar.gz || tar -czf /tmp/nipype-diag.tar.gz -T /dev/null
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
